mil7.6.9:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, sappassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti.
mil7.6.9:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena paññāya caritabbaṃ; paññāya caramānassa kho mahārāja yogino cittaṃ ñāye carati, vilakkhaṇaṃ vivajjeti salakkhaṇaṃ bhāveti.
mil7.6.9:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja sappassa pathamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.9:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sappo caramāno osadhaṃ parivajjento carati,
mil7.6.9:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena duccaritaṃ parivajjentena caritabbaṃ.
mil7.6.9:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sappassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.9:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sappo manusse disvā tappati socati cintayati,
mil7.6.9:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kuvitakke vitakketvā aratiṃ uppādayitvā tappitabbaṃ socitabbaṃ cintayitabbaṃ: pamādena me divaso vītināmito, na so puna sakkā laddhun-ti.
mil7.6.9:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sappassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.9:3.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhallāṭiyajātake dvinnaṃ kinnarānaṃ:
